title: Grilled Steak Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with grilled steak, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Buttery Australian Steak
ingredients.notes: Look for a marbling score of 3-5 for the best flavor and tenderness

ingredients.name: Wrap
ingredients.notes: Choose a sturdy wrap that can hold the filling

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add the steak to the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing sliced steak in the center and serving with your favorite toppings.
